title: CS momentum check - QBR & renewals scratchpad
body:
Quick brain dump for today (scrappy). Goal: 3 high-impact follow-ups + 1 renewal move.

Top priority (timebox 09:00-11:30)
- ACME Corp (renewal: 2026-06-18) — need final SKU confirmation and cost backup.
  - Send updated committed capacity worksheet (attach numbers from billing report).
  - Ask finance if we can push proposed start-of-term to 6/22 to align with end-of-month billing. (Maya to check)
  - Risk: their infra lead is OOO next week. If no answer by 6/04, schedule a short sync to lock contract terms.

- VegaHealth (QBR prep, meeting 2026-06-07)
  - Slide updates: usage trends (tokens/day), p95 latency improvements since quantization trial, top two regressions flagged by Optimize.
  - Pull traces & sample prompts with regressions (use Trace UI, filter model=redwood-7b-q4f).
  - Hypothesis to test during QBR: incremental caching yielded 12% cost drop but increased tail latency on long contexts — propose conservative cache TTL.
  - Deck TODO: add one customer quote about reliability (ask CSM for phrasing).

- Orion Media (support escalation)
  - Ticket #INC-9821: reported model truncation for long chat sessions. Eng triage assigned (SRE). Need ETA and workaround to communicate to customer.
  - Temporary workaround: lower max_new_tokens, confirm impact on user flows.
  - Log follow-ups: update ticket with sample prompt and kv-cache diagnostics (copy from Debugging notes).

Morning quick wins (30–60 min each)
- Quick follow: send intro + agenda to new POC @ Northstar (cold handoff).
- Close loop on billing discrepancy for ZetaAnalytics (opened 5/21) — attach line items and short note.
- Ping product for roadmap ask: fine-grained rollout controls for model variant fallback (link to Jira-4532).

Meeting prep checklist (for any QBRs today/week)
- 1 slide: success metrics (usage, latency, cost) — 3 bullets, be explicit.
- 1 slide: asks (billing, policy, product) — clear next steps per ask.
- 1 appendix: 5 sample prompts showing behavior before/after tuning.
- Bring escalation matrix + who to call for infra emergencies.

Notes to self / scripting bits
- When asking for committed capacity numbers, always include: expected avg concurrency, peak tokens/hr, SLO target (p95 <= X ms).
- Use cost-per-1M-token numbers from Finance deck (v2) instead of ad-hoc estimates.

Things to call out in customer comms (short bullets)
- We’ve reduced per-token cost by ~12% for your workload via caching + smaller variants; we recommend a conservative rollout to confirm no quality regressions.
- If you need data residency guarantees, refer to Private deployment options — I can loop in Solutions Eng.

Open questions / quick TODOs
- Who owns the VegaHealth sentiment example? (Hector? — assign and follow up)
- Confirm whether ACME wants monthly or quarterly invoices.
- Check if Orion Media has recent log-archiving enabled (if not, ask SRE to enable for diagnostics).

Time blocks for today (rough)
- 08:30 — 09:00: triage inbox + flag urgent tickets.
- 09:00 — 11:30: ACME renewal email + attach worksheet, VegaHealth traces grab.
- 11:30 — 12:00: quick sync with Maya on pricing ask.
- 13:30 — 14:30: work on VegaHealth deck + slide notes.
- 15:00 — 16:00: Orion Media escalation follow-up + ticket update.
- 16:30 — 17:00: admin + update Confluence QBR playbook with any new checklist bits.

Personal reminder
- Block 10–10:30 for deep work (no Slack) — try to finish ACME worksheet before that.
- Keep notes short, move action items to Jira if they require cross-team work.

Random seed thoughts (scratch)
- Could offer a small pilot discount if ACME signs before 6/10 to offset their internal procurement lag — but need approval from revenue ops.
- For VegaHealth, prepare an A/B slide: current rollout vs conservative cache TTL impact on tail latency.

End-of-day deliverables (quick checklist)
- Email sent to ACME with worksheet attached.
- Deck skeleton uploaded to GitHub PR for VegaHealth.
- Orion ticket updated with SRE ETA and next steps.

-- Elijah
